data.explanation: The Landratsamt Beispielkreis (district office) is ordering you to cut back your hedge because it extends into the public pavement and blocks sightlines at a road junction, citing Art. 29 BayStrWG. If you disagree, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically, or in person at the Landratsamt; the app shows the deadline for this. If you don't object, the order becomes final (Bestandskraft) and you must then trim the hedge within three weeks. Take photos once done as proof. If you're unsure whether to object, consider seeking legal advice or contacting the Landratsamt directly.

items.action: Once the order becomes legally final (Bestandskraft) — i.e. after the objection period has passed without an objection, or any objection has been decided — cut the hedge back to the property line within three weeks.

data.summary: The Landratsamt Beispielkreis (Sachgebiet 32 – Öffentliche Sicherheit und Ordnung) orders Jonas Mustermann to trim back a hedge that extends up to 1.20 m into the pavement near a junction with the Kreisstraße RO 5, to be done within three weeks after the order becomes final. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
